messages:
Zoe: Quick find during accessibility pass: VoiceOver reads the canary pill and then the collapsed row label, so users hear the allocation twice (e.g. "Canary 12%. Canary 12%"). :grimacing: Cal: Repro on macOS/Safari. Seems like both an aria-live on the pill and an accessible label on the collapsed container are firing. Rina: I couldn't repro with NVDA; sounds VoiceOver-specific. Could be DOM order vs visual order causing duplicate announces. Hector: Can we hide the collapsed label from assistive tech (aria-hidden="true") and keep a single sr-only aria-live inside the pill? Minimal risk change. Zoe: That sounds right. Also noticed keyboard focus outline for small variant pills disappears in high contrast mode need a 2px token-based focus ring. Cal: Microcopy: the action currently says "Pause rollout" but product intent is to pause only the canary variant. Recommend changing to "Pause canary" and sync the tooltip to match. Demo yesterday confused a PM. Rina: Agreed on the copy change. For the double announcement, quick patch idea: ``` Canary allocation updated to 12%
Canary 12%
``` Hector: Nice. Put it behind a feature flag and add an e2e that asserts only one live region update. I'll do the focus ring CSS update in the same PR. Zoe: Another issue: when scrubbing the timeline and clicking rollback, the confirm modal shows the current time instead of the snapshot time. I think modal uses Date.now() instead of selectedSnapshot.timestamp. Cal: Oof, saw that in a demo too. Modal header should be explicit: "Rollback to snapshot v2.6.0 1 2025-10-02 13:11 UTC" and primary CTA should read "Rollback to snapshot" (avoid generic "Confirm"). Rina: I'll fix the modal to pull selectedSnapshot.timeISO and add a unit test. Also add aria-describedby for the warning text: "This will revert traffic and restart variant pods. Metrics will be preserved." Hector: Plan: small PR with 1) aria-hidden duplicate label + sr-only live region, 2) change button + tooltip copy to "Pause canary", 3) focus ring for tiny pills. Assigning @Rina to modal timestamp + copy changes. UIBot: Accessibility scan queued: AR-2025-211 duplicate-live-region (severity: medium). Zoe: Please include VoiceOver + NVDA manual test steps in the PR checklist. I'll run VoiceOver verification after feature-flag rollout. Thanks!
